purpose: Production-ready Iteration 2 visual assets; not flattened app screens

raster_assets.prompt: A realistic horizontal smartphone evidence photo of exactly eight sealed plain cardboard boxes on two wooden pallets in a clean logistics loading bay. Entire shipment visible, bright neutral daylight. No people, vehicle, text, labels, barcode, logo, watermark, personal data or UI.

A realistic horizontal smartphone evidence photo through the open rear doors of a white box truck: exactly eight plain cardboard boxes on two pallets, firmly secured by two orange ratchet straps. No people, text, labels, barcode, logo, watermark, license plate or UI.

A realistic horizontal smartphone proof-of-delivery photo of four sealed plain cardboard boxes stacked safely at a clean urban building entrance, with a dark door and a small green plant. No people, address, house number, text, labels, logo, watermark, personal data or UI.

dynamic_assets.google_map: Render through Google Maps Flutter at runtime; do not ship a screenshot tile.
dynamic_assets.payos_qr: Generate from the mock/real checkout payload; do not ship a fixed payment QR.
dynamic_assets.countdown: Render as a Flutter timer/progress ring so accessibility and state remain correct.

icon_style: Original 24-unit SVGs, 1.8-unit rounded stroke, no embedded color dependency beyond the base #20252B for Flutter color filtering.
